grades: Entering grades 10 to 12 (some programs grades 11 to 12)
pay_detail: Tuition varies by program (amount not read on the pages fetched). Limited aid: scholarships usually cover 75 to 100% of the fee, based on need.
name: Tufts Pre-College Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take a summer program of 1 to 6 weeks for high schoolers. Tufts teachers lead it. Topics include Mini Med School, engineering with AI, business basics, studio art and leading for social change.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 10 to 12, or last spring's high school graduates. Residential students must be at least 15 at the start and no older than 19 at the end. Health programs need grades 11 to 12, 1 year of biology and age 16. Homeschoolers can apply. International students can apply.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open Dec 14, 2026. Close date not posted. Aid decisions are made twice a month starting in February.
how_to_apply: Apply online with a transcript. Add a letter where one is needed. Add a form where a parent says yes. See the How to Apply page.
notes: Costs money; check each program page for the price. Many 2027 dates say coming soon.
